addPrinter.connected.heading: Printer connected
addPrinter.connected.lead: It is in your printers list and ready to print.
addPrinter.connected.note: It reports its state to this server now.
addPrinter.connected.title: {printer} is connected
addPrinter.help.address: The file may hold an address the printer cannot reach. Check the address in step 1, then load the file again.
addPrinter.help.again: If the printer showed no code, choose Add Printer to Connect again.
addPrinter.help.firewall: A firewall on this computer may block the printer. Allow incoming connections to this server's port.
addPrinter.help.heading: The printer does not appear
addPrinter.help.network: The printer and this server must be on the same network, or the network must let them reach each other.
addPrinter.help.status.dns.means: The printer cannot find the host name in the file. Use this server's IP address instead.
addPrinter.help.status.heading: What the printer's Prusa Connect screen says
addPrinter.help.status.network.means: The printer has no working network connection. Check its cable or its Wi-Fi.
addPrinter.help.status.refused.means: Nothing answers at the address and port in the file. Check that this server runs and that no firewall blocks the printer.
addPrinter.help.status.server.means: Something answered, but it was not this server's printer connection. Check the address and the port in the file.
addPrinter.help.status.unauthorized.mean: This server does not know the printer's token. Choose Add Printer to Connect again and approve the new code.
addPrinter.loading.label: Loading how printers join this server
addPrinter.loopback.note: On a printer, {host} is the printer itself. Open this page at the address the server has on the network, or set the address printers use in the server configuration.
addPrinter.loopback.title: Printers cannot reach this server at {host}
addPrinter.pair.fallback: You can always add the printer with the settings file below.
addPrinter.pair.heading: Pair from the printer's screen
addPrinter.pair.lead: Type the printer's address. The printer asks whether to pair with this server, and you press Yes on it. You need no USB drive and no code to type.
addPrinter.pair.printer.hint: The IP address the printer shows under Settings, Network. Add a port, such as :8080, if its web page is not on port 80.
addPrinter.pair.printer.label: Printer address
addPrinter.pair.server.long: A printer stores at most 20 characters of a server name, and {host} is longer, so the printer will refuse the pairing. Use this server's IP address.
addPrinter.pair.server.note: The printer stores this address when you press Yes, and connects to it from then on. Change it if the printer reaches this server at another address.
addPrinter.pair.server.own: On a printer, {host} is the printer itself. Use the address this server has on your network.
addPrinter.pair.state.approved: The printer accepted. It is registering with this server now.
addPrinter.pair.state.expired: Nobody answered on the printer in time, or the printer did not register. If the printer shows a code from this server, approve that code on this page.
addPrinter.pair.state.refused: Somebody pressed Cancel on the printer
addPrinter.pair.state.waiting: Check that the printer at {printer} shows this code, then press Yes on the printer. The question closes after one minute.
addPrinter.prepare.address: The file sends the printer to {host}. The printer must be able to reach this address on your network.
addPrinter.prepare.copy: Copy the file to a USB drive, in the top folder and not inside another folder.
addPrinter.prepare.customCert: Download connect.der and copy it to the same place on the drive.
addPrinter.prepare.customCert.missing: This server has no certificate file to offer. Export the certificate of your own authority as a DER file, and copy it to the drive as connect.der.
addPrinter.prepare.download.label: Download {file}
addPrinter.prepare.lead: This file tells the printer the address of this server.
addPrinter.prepare.plug: Put the drive in the printer.
addPrinter.prepare.title: Prepare the settings file
addPrinter.printer.add: Choose Add Printer to Connect. If the printer says that a previous registration will be forgotten, choose Yes.
addPrinter.printer.code.approval: The printer shows a code. Leave it on the screen and choose Next here.
addPrinter.printer.code.automatic: The printer shows a code. This server approves it at once. Choose Next here.
addPrinter.printer.lead: Do these steps on the printer's display. Keep this page open.
addPrinter.printer.load: Choose Load Settings. The printer says Loaded successfully. If it asks you to enable Connect, switch Connect on.
addPrinter.printer.noConfig: The Status line then says No Config. That is expected: the printer joins after the next step.
addPrinter.printer.note: You do not need to switch Connect off and on again.
addPrinter.printer.open: Open this menu on the printer's display.
addPrinter.printer.title: Set up the printer
addPrinter.reject.note: The request is dropped. The printer can ask again, so one you do not recognise comes back until it is switched off or configured differently.
addPrinter.reject.title: Reject {printer}?
addPrinter.steps.connected.caption: Ready to print
addPrinter.steps.label: Steps to add a printer
addPrinter.steps.prepare.caption: Download the settings file
addPrinter.steps.printer.caption: A few taps on the printer
addPrinter.title: Add a printer
addPrinter.values.heading: Show the file and connection values
addPrinter.values.note: You can also type these values on the printer instead of loading the file.
addPrinter.wait.approvedNote: The printer may say Registration successful, continue at connect.prusa3d.com. You can ignore that. It connects to this server.
addPrinter.wait.compare: Check that the printer shows this code.
addPrinter.wait.lead.approval: The printer appears here as soon as it asks to join. Check its code, then approve it.
addPrinter.wait.lead.automatic: This server approves every printer that asks. The printer appears here as soon as it asks to join.
addPrinter.wait.listeningNote.approval: Nothing has asked to join yet. After you choose Add Printer to Connect on the printer, it appears here within a few seconds.
addPrinter.wait.listeningNote.automatic: Nothing has asked to join yet. After you choose Add Printer to Connect on the printer, it joins within a few seconds.
addPrinter.wait.refused.notAdmitted: This server does not accept this printer, for example because it was removed from the printers list. Ask the administrator of this server.
addPrinter.wait.refused.title: This server refused {printer}
addPrinter.wait.refused.unknownCredentia: The printer used a token this server did not give it. On the printer, choose Add Printer to Connect again, then approve the new code here.
addPrinter.waiting.caption: Printers waiting for approval, with the code and fingerprint to check against each printer's own display
addPrinter.waiting.heading: Printers waiting for approval
addPrinter.waiting.note: Check the code and fingerprint against each printer's own display before you approve it. A name in this list was chosen by whoever set the printer up, so it proves nothing.
